avis.titre: My dark spots are visibly brighter and smoother
avis.texte: [I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.] I've been using the L'Oreal Paris Triple Power Melasyl Cream serum consistently for about 7 weeks now. It also didn't sting or irritate my skin. The pump dispenses the perfect amount of product, and being able to close it after each use keeps the nozzle clean without leaving product residue behind. The bottle is also super cute and looks great on my vanity. My only suggestion would be to add the expiration date to the packaging. The biggest change I've noticed was my hyperpigmentation spots and overall skin tone. My before and after photos show that my ￼hyperpigmentation has definitely faded and they are much lighter than when I started. While my dark spots haven't disappeared completely, they are less visible, and my complexion looks more even. My skin also feels softer and more hydrated. Overall, I would absolutely purchase this product. There is definite improvement in my hyperpigmention/dark spots. My skin looks brighter and smoother looking. I'm excited to see what even long-term results look like.
